summary.short: California AB 1043 (Digital Age Assurance Act), operative January 1, 2027, requires operating system providers to obtain account-holder age information and send age-bracket signals to app developers, requires developers to request and apply those signals, and provides Attorney General civil penalties for violations.
summary.long: AB 1043 (Statutes of 2025, ch. 675) adds the Digital Age Assurance Act, Civil Code Sections 1798.500 to 1798.505, operative January 1, 2027. Operating system providers must offer an account-setup interface for an account holder to indicate the user's birth date or age, and a real-time interface giving developers a signal of one of four age brackets (under 13, 13 to under 16, 16 to under 18, 18 and over), limiting data sharing to purposes required by the title. Developers must request a signal when an application is downloaded and launched, are deemed to have actual knowledge of the user's age range, and treat the signal as the primary age indicator unless they hold clear and convincing contrary information. Existing devices and applications have a July 1, 2027 compliance date. Operating system providers and covered application stores must not treat their own apps more favorably than third-party apps and must not use third-party data collected under the title to compete against those third parties. Broadband, telecommunications and physical products are excluded. The Attorney General may seek an injunction and civil penalties of up to $2,500 per affected child for negligent violations or $7,500 for intentional violations.

notes: Identifier fields use empty strings where the codebook says null, because the schema types them as strings. The Legislative Counsel's Digest is summary text and was not used as a source for operative provisions. Internal tension: “User” is defined as a child who is the primary user of the device (1798.500(i)), yet the signal duties in 1798.501(a)(2)(D) and (b) cover all age brackets, including At least 18 years of age; the text does not reconcile these. Section 1798.505 makes the title operative on January 1, 2027. The relation and entity sections are populated above; the section_status entries are included only because the schema requires them.

evidence.quote: At least 18 years of age.
means an individual who is at least 18 years of age or a parent or legal guardian of a user who is under 18 years of age in the state.
means nonpersonally identifiable data derived from a user’s birth date or age for the purpose of sharing with developers of applications
means a software application that may be run or directed by a user on a computer, a mobile device, or any other general purpose computing device
means a natural person who is under 18 years of age.
means a publicly available internet website, software application, online service, or platform that distributes and facilitates the download of applications from third-party developers to users
does not mean an online service or platform that distributes extensions, plug-ins, add-ons, or other software applications that run exclusively within a separate host application.
means a person that owns, maintains, or controls an application.
means a person or entity that develops, licenses, or controls the operating system software on a computer, mobile device, or any other general purpose computing device.
means age bracket data sent by a real-time secure application programming interface or operating system to an application.
means a child that is the primary user of the device.

obligations.summary: Operating system provider shall provide an accessible account-setup interface requiring the account holder to indicate the user's birth date or age, and shall provide a developer that requested it a real-time API signal of the user's age bracket (under 13, 13-15, 16-17, 18 or over).

evidence.quote: Provide an accessible interface at account setup that requires an account holder to indicate the birth date, age, or both, of the user of that device

obligations.summary: Operating system provider shall send only the minimum amount of information necessary to comply with the title and shall not share the digital signal information with a third party for a purpose not required by the title.

evidence.quote: Send only the minimum amount of information necessary to comply with this title

obligations.summary: Developer shall request an age signal for a particular user from an operating system provider or a covered application store when the application is downloaded and launched.

evidence.quote: A developer shall request a signal with respect to a particular user from an operating system provider or a covered application store when the application is downloaded and launched.

obligations.summary: Developer shall not willfully disregard internal clear and convincing information indicating that a user's age differs from the signal; the signal is the primary indicator of age unless the developer holds contrary clear and convincing information, which it shall then use.

evidence.quote: A developer shall not willfully disregard internal clear and convincing information

obligations.summary: Developer shall use the received signal to comply with applicable law, shall not request from an operating system provider or covered application store more information than the minimum necessary, and shall not share the signal with a third party for a purpose not required by the title.

evidence.quote: shall use that signal to comply with applicable law but shall not do either of the following

obligations.summary: For devices whose account setup was completed before January 1, 2027, operating system provider shall provide an accessible interface allowing the account holder to indicate the user's birth date or age.

evidence.quote: an operating system provider shall, before July 1, 2027, provide an accessible interface that allows an account holder to indicate the birth date, age, or both

obligations.summary: For applications last updated on or after January 1, 2026 and downloaded before January 1, 2027, where the developer has not requested a signal for that user, the developer shall request a signal from a covered application store.

evidence.quote: the developer shall request a signal from a covered application store with respect to that user before July 1, 2027

obligations.summary: Operating system provider or covered application store shall comply with the title in a nondiscriminatory manner, including by imposing at least the same restrictions and obligations on its own applications and distribution as on third-party applications or distributors.

evidence.quote: shall impose at least the same restrictions and obligations on its own applications

obligations.summary: Operating system provider or covered application store shall not use data collected from a third party in the course of compliance to compete against that third party, give its own store preference, or otherwise use such data or the consent mechanism anticompetitively.

evidence.quote: shall not use data collected from a third party in the course of compliance with this title to compete against that third party
